symptom: 5G User Authentication failure rate surged to 34% across core network gateways.
query: Mobile subscribers are experiencing cellular network attachment failures and authentication timeouts against the core network.
context: Runbook: 5G Core Network HSS Diameter Connection Pool. Cause: Diameter protocol connection pool exhaustion on hss-service (Home Subscriber Server) under subscriber registration wave. Fix: 1. Verify active connection pool count on hss-service. 2. Scale hss-service connection pool capacity to 500. 3. Restart diameter gateway proxy.
reference: The subscriber authentication failures are caused by Diameter connection pool exhaustion on the hss-service (Home Subscriber Server). Scale the diameter connection pool configuration and restart the gateway proxy.

symptom: Session Management Function (SMF) pod terminating with OOMKilled exit code 137 under data session load.
query: Session Management Function (SMF) pod crashed with OOMKilled exit code 137, dropping active user data sessions.
context: Runbook: SMF Session Context Memory Leak. Cause: Leaked PDP context session handles in smf-service upon abnormal subscriber disconnect. Fix: 1. Check pdp_context_allocated_bytes metric. 2. Increase smf-service container memory to 2Gi. 3. Enable automatic stale PDP context reap timer.
reference: The SMF pod crash is caused by a memory leak in PDP context handle retention in smf-service leading to an OOMKilled termination (exit code 137). Increase memory limit to 2Gi and configure stale context reaping.

symptom: Inter-account fund transfers deadlocking on account balance updates with PostgreSQL serialization failures.
query: Banking core transaction transfer API is failing with SQL transaction deadlocks during concurrent account transfers.
context: Runbook: Banking Transaction Manager Deadlock Resolution. Cause: Inconsistent account locking order (source vs destination account) in transaction-manager causing cross-transaction database deadlocks. Fix: 1. Enforce strict numerical order locking on account IDs. 2. Configure optimistic concurrency control for transfers. 3. Terminate deadlocked backend sessions in Postgres.
reference: The transfer failures are caused by database deadlocks in the transaction-manager due to inconsistent account row locking order (postgres_deadlock_conflicts_total spike). Enforce strict account ID ordering before acquiring row-level locks.

telemetry.logs_summary: transaction-manager: org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: ERROR: deadlock detected on relation 'account_balance'

symptom: Account history query API latency spiked to 6500ms; account-service CPU utilization at 100%.
query: Customers cannot view bank account statement history; account-service is pinned at 100% CPU and timing out.
context: Runbook: Account Service Statement Query CPU Overload. Cause: Sequential scan on unindexed transaction timestamp column in account-service database query. Fix: 1. Add index on (account_id, transaction_timestamp). 2. Add Redis query caching for account statement history. 3. Scale account-service pods.
reference: The statement history query timeout is caused by CPU saturation on account-service (container_cpu_usage_seconds_total at 100%) due to unindexed full table scans. Add composite database index and cache statement queries in Redis.

symptom: Stock trading order execution delayed by 8500ms; order-matching-engine CPU overloaded.
query: Trading order execution latency has spiked to over 8 seconds with order-matching-engine backlog accumulating.
context: Runbook: Market Order Matching Engine CPU Contention. Cause: Runaway limit order book sorting queue in order-matching-engine under high market volatility. Fix: 1. Enable batch order processing mode. 2. Partition limit order book across symbol shards. 3. Allocate dedicated high-frequency CPU cores to matching engine.
reference: The order execution delay is caused by CPU contention on the order-matching-engine as the order book queue depth accumulated during volatility. Partition order books by trading symbol shards and assign dedicated CPU cores.

symptom: Real-time stock price feed multicast experiencing 4000ms network latency jitter across market participants.
query: Real-time ticker market data feed multicast has high packet latency and dropped price updates.
context: Runbook: Market Data Gateway Network Jitter. Cause: Network interface buffer overrun and latency delay on market-data-gateway. Fix: 1. Check network_latency_ms on gateway multicast interface. 2. Increase socket receive buffer size (net.core.rmem_max). 3. Restart market-data-gateway multicast publisher.
reference: The ticker feed lag is caused by network latency delay and buffer overrun on market-data-gateway (network_latency_ms > 3500ms). Increase socket receive buffer size and reset network multicast queue rules.
